summary: A step state change written on this member now records the step's change time as its claim's acceptance time, the time a replay and every other member record, instead of the writer's clock reading taken just before the claim

replay.detail: No replay at upgrade. A step row written before the change keeps its earlier time, a millisecond or so before the claim's, until its next state change or a replay.

schema.detail: No table, column or file change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change. step_runs.updated_at_unix_ms is left out of the projection digest; activated_at_unix_ms was already normalized and is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or CLI change. A local reader can see a step's updated time move forward by a millisecond or so, to the claim's time.
